out.subject: Your offer for stainless bar – proposed contract package
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the cost drivers. We value the relationship too. I understand your point about alloy, labour and processing costs; alongside those movements, your own order history for this item is a useful basis for reviewing the price. Please see the purchase-order figures below.

Our annual requirement is 23700 kg. Rather than continuing on a short contract, we propose a 24-month agreement at EUR 5.20 per kg, with payment at 90 days net and no price adjustment clause. DAP remains the delivery basis. Please consider the price and commercial terms as a complete package.

I have attached our monthly demand forecast so you can assess the volume pattern behind the requirement. Can you support this package on the basis of the documented orders and the longer contract term?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Open with the prescribed package nearest the requested opening level, supported by the supplier's own purchase-order record and the attached forecast. Acknowledge its cost explanation while asking it to assess the complete commercial package.

out.subject: Re: Bar supply – revised commercial package
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for reviewing the order history and forecast, and for supporting a 24-month agreement with payment at 90 days net. That gives us a useful basis to continue.

I understand that you require an AS-14404 clause because of raw material volatility. Your revised offer therefore differs from the fixed-price arrangement we proposed. Could you review whether the forecast and longer contract term allow you to support that arrangement instead?

We can raise our proposal to EUR 5.25 per kg, retaining the 24-month term, payment at 90 days net and no price adjustment clause. DAP remains the delivery basis. Please assess these terms together as a complete package.

I have attached the latest shared forecast again; see the figures below for the documented update. Please use this snapshot in your review and let us know whether you can support the revised package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Raises the price modestly while retaining the previously proposed commercial terms, acknowledges the supplier's clause requirement, and supplies the latest forecast evidence for its review.

out.subject: Re: Bar supply – revised contract package
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for reducing the price and confirming the longer term and payment conditions. I also note that the updated forecast is already reflected in your calculation.

To answer your volume question precisely: the annual volume for the proposed agreement is 23700 kg. We can commit to that fixed requirement, but are not proposing a higher quantity. The forecast gives you the monthly demand pattern behind it.

I understand that you regard the alloy surcharge clause as necessary for the longer term. Before we settle that point, please have your pricing committee review the fixed-price package alongside the documented alloy index figures below.

We can raise our proposal to EUR 5.27 per kg for a 24-month agreement, with payment at 90 days net and no price adjustment clause. DAP remains unchanged. Please consider the annual volume and these commercial terms together, and let us know whether your committee can support this revised package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Answers the volume question using the fixed annual requirement, acknowledges that the forecast was already considered and that the supplier requires a surcharge clause, and makes a small price concession while requesting committee review with fresh verified alloy-index evidence.

out.subject: Re: Revised offer for stainless bar
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for recognising the alloy index movement and reducing your offer. I note your distinction between the surcharge options and your position that an AS-14404 clause is necessary for the longer agreement.

To resolve that point, we are prepared to include the AS-14404 clause from your EUR 5.30 offer: a 45% material share, no deadband and base month 2026-08. With that change, our revised package is EUR 5.27 per kg, payment at 90 days net and a 24-month contract. DAP remains unchanged.

You also identify processing as a main price driver. Please see the documented PPI-C2431 figures below and consider that movement alongside the alloy reduction you have already verified. This is a separate data point, not a further forecast update.

Can you support this package with your surcharge mechanism retained and the processing movement reflected in the price?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Addresses the mandatory surcharge condition by adopting the supplier's existing clause, while retaining payment and contract duration. Uses the newly available processing index evidence to support a modest reduction from the standing offer without repeating the prior fixed-price package.
